translations.name: THE 11 BEST HOTELS IN TORRES DEL PAINE
translations.subtitle: ACCORDING TO CHILE ADICTO HOTELES ED TRAVEL
description: Luxury “destination hotels” are not found only abroad. In our country we have many of them, and that is exactly what Chile Adicto Hoteles, the first guide of its kind in Chile, aims to highlight. Here, we have selected the 11 best places in this category in Torres del Paine, in collaboration with ED magazine.

Acá, elegimos los 11 mejores lugares de esta categoría en Torres del Paine, en colaboración con revista ED.

translations.name: EMOL, “HE THOUGHT IT / HE DID IT”

description: The luxury accommodation guide for various destinations was founded eight years ago by Miñano and Rodrigo Guendelman, where they combined their experience in media and tourism to create this platform.

translations.name: ED – TRAVEL
translations.subtitle: WHAT ARE THE BEST HOTELS IN CHILE?
description: The director of Closer Publishing, Patricio Miñano, teamed up with Rodrigo Guendelman and Imagen País to combine their expertise in creating a guide to the finest hotels in Chile. These hotels blend architecture, gastronomy, design, and, of course, stunning landscapes.

translations.name: ED – VIAJES
translations.subtitle: ¿CUALES SON LOS MEJORES HOTELES DE CHILE?
description: El director de la editorial Closer, Patricio Miñano, se unió a Rodrigo Guendelman y a Imagen País, donde ambos combinaron su experiencia para crear una guía con los mejores hoteles de nuestro país. Esos que combinan arquitectura, gastronomía, diseño y, por supuesto, un paisaje único.
